classification.difficultyReason: Construct a parallel auxiliary segment, establish an isosceles triangle and use similarity to deduce the required ratio.

content.prompt: $\triangle ABC$ is an isosceles triangle. $L$ is a point on $BC$ produced so that there are points $N$ and $M$ on $AB$ and $AC$, respectively, so that $NM=ML$. Find the ratio $BN:CM$.

spec.description: Unshaded isosceles triangle with matching single ticks on AB and AC. B, C and L lie on one horizontal line in that order. N lies on AB, M lies on AC, and N, M and L are collinear. Ordinary source blue strokes are reconstructed in house black.
spec.mathematics: AB=AC; NM=ML; N is on AB; M is on AC; C is between B and L; M is between N and L.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are shown. No auxiliary construction or required ratio is supplied.

answer.short:
$BN:CM=2:1$.

Draw $MX\parallel AB$ with $X$ on $BC$. Isosceles-triangle angles give $MX=MC$, and similarity gives $BN=2MX$.
answer.worked:
Draw $MX\parallel AB$, meeting $BC$ at $X$.

Since $AB=AC$, $\angle ABC=\angle BCA$. Also, $\angle MXC=\angle ABC$ and $\angle MCX=\angle BCA$. Hence $\triangle MXC$ is isosceles, so $MX=MC$.

In $\triangle LNB$ and $\triangle LMX$, $\angle NLB=\angle MLX$ because they are the same angle, and $\angle LBN=\angle LXM$ because $BN\parallel XM$. Thus $\triangle LNB\sim\triangle LMX$ (AAA), with corresponding vertices in that order.

Since $NM=ML$ and $N,M,L$ are collinear,
$$\begin{align*}LN&=NM+ML\\LN&=2ML\\\frac{BN}{MX}&=\frac{LN}{LM}\\\frac{BN}{MX}&=2\\BN&=2MX\\BN&=2CM.\end{align*}$$
Therefore $BN:CM=2:1$.
